title: QA corpus stamps runner_enforced from a JSON field with zero binding to any runner artifact (bin/record-playtest-session.ts:217)
body:
Deferred from the 2026-08-28/29 audit fix pass. The finding was confirmed by an
adversarial verifier; it was not fixed in that pass for the reason below, which is
the fixing agent's own account after reading the code.

Outside my ownership: the fix belongs in bin/record-playtest-session.ts and src/qa/* (session_record.client_evidence is declared there and never written by anything). My providers.json change removes two of the three forgeable vendors from the metrics lever — a hand-written claude_code or gemini_cli record is now stamped operator_attested and cannot move experience numbers — but a fabricated `codex` record still can, and the family-diversity promotion lever the verifier identified is untouched. The recorder still needs to require a real runner artifact (sidecar/envelope/rollout capture) before stamping runner_enforced.
